question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Agressive"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Aggressive". (आक्रामक)

 
 
• **Example: **His **aggressive** behavior was not tolerated in the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Aggressive"** means ready or likely to attack or confront; characterized by or resulting from aggression. (आक्रामक)
 
 
• **Example: **The company is taking an **aggressive** approach to expand its market share.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Agressive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apparent **(स्पष्ट): Clearly visible or understood; obvious.

 
 
• **Example:** It was apparent that she was not happy with the decision.
 
 
 
• **Skewed **(तिरछा): Not straight, crooked, or slanted.
 
 
• **Example: **The statistics are skewed because they only include data from a small sample.
 
 
 
• **Creator** (निर्माता): A person or thing that brings something into existence.
 
 
• **Example:** She is known as the creator of several popular television shows.
